what: How each Montana place voted in six contests of the 2020 and 2024 general elections: the votes for the Democratic ticket, the Republican ticket, every other candidate on the ballot together and the total, added up from the Montana Secretary of State's official precinct results and the State Canvass.
note: What this is: how the people of a place voted in that election, in the Secretary of State's official precinct results and the State Canvass, added up here by county and by judicial district and, for 2024, given by state House, state Senate and Public Service Commission district, on the lines in force at that election. What this is not: it is not a prediction of any election; it says nothing about any candidate on a later ballot or about any voter; a nonpartisan office stays nonpartisan; and a place is not its lines for ever: where a district was drawn again, the figures are for the lines of that year. Montana elected no senator and no statewide partisan officer in 2022, so there is no 2022 contest. Declared write-in votes are canvassed apart and are not in these figures. The tickets are named, as the Secretary's own results name them, only to say which election this was. In a place with very few voters the split would come close to saying how particular people voted, so there the split is left out.

few.why: A place's too_few lists the contests in which it had fewer than 20 votes, or in which every vote went the same way. There the split comes close to saying how particular people voted, so a page should leave it out. The counts are the official record all the same, and are kept here so that the sums can be checked.

not_given: Cities and towns: a Montana precinct has a number and a local name, and the results do not say which city or town it lies in. County commissioner districts, wards, conservation districts and school districts: the results do not name them for a precinct.

house.what: State House districts of the plan first used in 2024
house.why_not: The 2020 election was held on the House districts drawn after the 2010 census; the districts drawn after the 2020 census were first used in 2024, so 2020 is not given.
house.note: The figures are the Total rows of the State Canvass by House district. 4 precincts are split between two House districts (SOUTH BELKNAP 15, Blaine County; PRECINCT #14, Hill County; 02 BAINVILLE, Roosevelt County; 12 CULBERTSON, Roosevelt County); everywhere else the precincts add up to the same figures.

senate.what: State Senate districts of the plan first used in 2024
senate.why_not: The 2020 election was held on the House districts drawn after the 2010 census; the districts drawn after the 2020 census were first used in 2024, so 2020 is not given.
senate.note: Senate district n is House districts 2n-1 and 2n. The precincts of the State Senator contests in the results show this for 50 of the 50 districts.

judicial.note: The counties of each district are those section 3-5-101, MCA, lists; every year's figures are those counties' votes.

psc.why_not: The 2020 election was held on the House districts drawn after the 2010 census; the districts drawn after the 2020 census were first used in 2024, so 2020 is not given.
psc.note: The House districts of each district are those section 69-1-104, MCA, lists (the districts in force from 2024). The precincts of the 2024 commission contests agree for districts 2, 3, 4.
